description:
## Why

The current `DeviationScope` is a closed enum with four variants (`Any`, `IssuerDnContains`, `IssuerDnExact`, `SerialRange`). PKIX-9vnx (Arch 2 / PKIX-ztmr stance) and the PKIX-9vnx.5 notes call for scope axes to live in an open-ended props bag rather than as enum variants, so new scope axes (e.g., PKIX-8mzp's `SubjectDnContains`, `PolicyOid`) can be added without growing the public enum surface.

The OSCAL Subject representation already supports this — an arbitrary `type` discriminator plus a typed-prop bag. The work here is to mirror that on the Rust side.

## What

Replace `pub enum DeviationScope { ... }` with a struct holding a typed-prop bag:

```rust
pub struct DeviationScope {
    /// Subject type discriminator, e.g. "pkix-lint.scope.issuer-dn-exact".
    pub kind: String,
    /// Typed props (name → value).
    pub props: Vec<(String, ScopePropValue)>,
}

pub enum ScopePropValue {
    Text(String),
    Bytes(Vec<u8>),
    // … future numeric / range / OID variants as needed
}
```

(Exact shape is open — `HashMap<String, String>` is also a candidate per the .5 notes. The `Vec<(String, _)>` form preserves insertion order, which matters for deterministic emit.)

Migrate the four current variants to canonical-kind constants:
- `"pkix-lint.scope.any"`
- `"pkix-lint.scope.issuer-dn-contains"` with prop `pkix-lint.issuer-dn-substring`
- `"pkix-lint.scope.issuer-dn-exact"` with prop `pkix-lint.issuer-dn-der` (DER bytes)
- `"pkix-lint.scope.serial-range"` with props `pkix-lint.issuer-dn-der`, `pkix-lint.serial-start`, `pkix-lint.serial-end`

Provide ergonomic constructors so today's call-sites stay readable:

```rust
impl DeviationScope {
    pub fn any() -> Self { ... }
    pub fn issuer_dn_contains(s: impl Into<String>) -> Self { ... }
    pub fn issuer_dn_exact(name: &Name) -> Result<Self, der::Error> { ... }
    pub fn serial_range(issuer: &Name, start: Vec<u8>, end: Vec<u8>) -> Result<Self, der::Error> { ... }
}
```

`DeviationScope::matches` dispatches on `kind`. Unknown kinds match nothing (fail-closed) and emit a warning via the runner's diagnostics.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `DeviationScope` is a struct (not a closed enum).
- [ ] Existing call-sites compile after migrating to constructor methods.
- [ ] PKIX-8mzp's `SubjectDnContains` / `PolicyOid` are expressible via new `kind` strings + props — no enum variant added.
- [ ] OSCAL emit and parse (PKIX-9vnx.10) work without any change to their subject-type discriminators.
- [ ] Existing deviation tests pass after migration.
- [ ] BREAKING change: bumped pkix-lint version, CHANGELOG entry describing the migration.

## Depends on

PKIX-9vnx.10 (parser must already exist so we can verify round-trip survives the refactor).

## Out of scope

- Specific new scope axes (those are PKIX-8mzp's domain; this bead is the structural prerequisite).
- DeviationStore persistence changes beyond what's required to keep round-trip working.

## Filed by

PKIX-9vnx.5 closure 2026-05-11 (the .5 notes call for this; deferred from the emit half).
title: pkix-lint: refactor DeviationScope from closed enum to open-ended props bag
